clean_tarball_install.method: npm local tgz install + real Harness component activation/execution/unload

live_numeric_verification.scope: fit fields, lookup fields, gaps, flags, rankings, boundary-note presence, rationale length and caveat presence; not a replacement for an official benchmark evaluator

limitations: Only the exact listed Harness release is certified by these local checks.

Task code needs an external sandbox when untrusted.
No broad scientific-quality improvement is established by these tests.
